requirement_text.ISS-0329: auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs:140 hardcodes idp_realm_id causing cross-partition unique constraint collision. Fix: use unique_realm/1 + dynamic Application.put_env for :oidc_jit_provisioning with on_exit cleanup.

task.description:
Implement the fix for ISS-0329 per the design in lib/letflow/design/iss0329-jit-disabled-realm-unique.md.

The ONLY file to change is: test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs

Specifically, in the 'JIT-disabled realm (403, distinct from every 401 case)' describe block's test body (currently line 140):

Replace:
  realm = "jit-disabled-test-realm"
  tenant = insert_tenant_for_realm!(realm)

With:
  realm = unique_realm("jit-disabled")
  original_jit_config = Application.fetch_env!(:letflow, :oidc_jit_provisioning)
  Application.put_env(:letflow, :oidc_jit_provisioning, Map.put(original_jit_config, realm, %{enabled: false, default_status: :active, default_roles: []}))
  on_exit(fn -> Application.put_env(:letflow, :oidc_jit_provisioning, original_jit_config) end)
  tenant = insert_tenant_for_realm!(realm)

The `unique_realm/1` helper already exists in the same file (lines 145-147).
The `Application.put_env` pattern mirrors the existing module-level setup/0 which already does this for config :letflow, :oidc.

Do NOT change any other file. Do NOT modify config/test.exs, lib/, scripts/, or any other test files.

After making the change:
1. Run `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` to confirm the file compiles cleanly
2. Run `mix test test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs` to confirm all 3 tests in the file pass (isolated, single-partition)
3. Run `mix format --check-formatted` on the changed file

If any step fails, fix and re-run before completing the handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Application.put_env(:letflow, :oidc_jit_provisioning, ...) with the unique realm added and on_exit cleanup precedes insert_tenant_for_realm!
mix format --check-formatted exits 0 for the changed file

result.summary: Replaced hardcoded 'jit-disabled-test-realm' with unique_realm("jit-disabled") and added dynamic Application.put_env for :oidc_jit_provisioning with on_exit cleanup. Only test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs modified. Commit: 4146622.
